provablyFair.a: Every case opening uses a commit-reveal scheme: before you open a case, our server generates a secret server seed and shows you only its hash. Your result is computed from that server seed, a client seed you control, and a nonce. Rotate your seed pair at any time to reveal the server seed used for your past opens and verify each result independently on the Verify page — the outcome could not have been chosen after the fact.

deposits.a: We support card payments, crypto, and CS2 skin deposits. Pick a method on the Wallet page — funds are credited to your balance once the payment provider confirms the transaction. Crypto deposits typically require a small number of network confirmations first.

kyc.q: Why do I need to verify my identity (KYC)?
kyc.a: As a licensed real-money operator we're required to verify player identity before withdrawals, in line with anti-money-laundering regulations. Submit your documents from the Profile page — most verifications complete within minutes.

withdrawals.a: Once your account is KYC-verified, request a withdrawal from the Wallet page via card, crypto, or CS2 skins. Withdrawals are reviewed for compliance and typically processed within 24 hours.

steam.q: Can I log in with Steam?
steam.a: Yes — click "Log in via Steam" and approve the request on Steam. We only read your public SteamID and profile info to create your account; we never see or store your Steam password.
